build_paa_model: build a PAA object detection model with ResNet50 backbone and FPN neck for COCO detection
create_paa_head: create a PAAHead bbox head with FocalLoss, GIoULoss, and CrossEntropyLoss for centerness
configure_data_preprocessor: configure DetDataPreprocessor with ImageNet mean/std and BGR-to-RGB conversion
setup_anchor_generator: setup AnchorGenerator with single ratio, octave base scale 8, and strides 8 to 128
run_training_pipeline: run PAA training with SGD optimizer, MaxIoUAssigner, and 1x COCO schedule
